Character Editor

The people of this world: pick a concept, then change the hair, beard, headwear and clothes, the build, the colours and the matte look, and see it move straight away in the arena. Save a look as a template, and hand one to the game as the hero. The settings can be copied out as text and pasted back in later.

Frames

Columns: standing, then four moments of the walk. Rows: south, west, east, north. Attacks are best judged in the arena.

Arena

Controls

WASD
Move. Hold Shift to sprint
J or Left click
Attack (three-hit combo). Hold to charge a heavy swing
K or Right click
Block
Space
Dash
F
Ranged shot
H
Spawn a bot

Figure

The Blender hero (2026-10-09, art/) is rendered sprite sheets: eight directions, idle and walk, the helmet and the mail as layers over the body. Walk him round the arena. The sliders below change only the drawn figure.

Heroes

Three heroes drawn from scratch on the ink figure (2026-10-07). Pick one, change anything below, then "Use as the hero in the game".

Concepts

Whole looks for the people of this world. Pick one, then change it below.

Animation

Side-to-side sway and Stance width only show when walking north or south. Sway at 1 is the old waddle.

Look and tone

Matte dulls the highlights, softens the colours and browns the outline toward the world's, like the trees.

Settings as text
